name: Rithvik Rajani Kanth Sasi
headline:
Thoughtful code.
Real-world impact.
intro: I’m Rithvik, a software engineer bringing applications, cloud infrastructure, and machine learning together to solve meaningful problems.
about: My work lives at the intersection of full-stack development, cloud-native architecture, and applied AI. At Accenture, I build scalable software and help bring machine learning workflows into production. I enjoy connecting the pieces: from the application people use to the infrastructure that keeps it running.

experience.description: Driving the architecture and implementation of scalable, cloud-native applications on AWS. Leading the integration of machine learning workflows into enterprise production environments.

Developed and deployed full-stack features, optimized cloud operations, and supported high system availability. Collaborated across teams to build data-driven pipelines and operationalize AI solutions.

projects.name: Road safety, through computer vision
projects.summary: Connecting number plate recognition with timestamp data to identify vehicles exceeding average speed limits.
projects.details: Two logging stations capture vehicle number plates and timestamps. The system matches records between stations, calculates average speed from the distance and elapsed time, and writes vehicles exceeding the limit to a CSV file.

projects.name: Machine learning meets the physical world
projects.summary: Real-time face mask detection, extended with a conceptual IoT entry-point system.
projects.details: The mask-detection project was extended with a conceptual system combining an MLX90614 temperature sensor, a Pi Camera v2, motion sensing, LEDs, and relays or automatic doors for an entry-point use case.

projects.name: Movies, discovery & a shared conversation
projects.summary: A movie discovery application with sign-in, trailer browsing, search, and global chat.
projects.details: Users can sign in, browse trailers across movie categories such as popular titles, search for a movie, and participate in a global chat alongside the discovery experience.

projects.name: Spam detection with the Gmail API
projects.summary: Retrieve email content with the Gmail API and classify messages as spam.
projects.details: An email subject is used to find a message and retrieve its body through the Gmail API. The message content is then used for spam detection.

projects.name: Malicious URL detection
projects.summary: Use URL-derived keywords and multiple models to assess whether a website may be malicious.
projects.details: The project extracts keywords from a URL and uses multiple models to produce a collection of predictions about whether the website may be malicious.

projects.name: Lane & object detection
projects.summary: Detect lanes and objects in a real-time video feed using OpenCV.
projects.details: A computer vision project exploring lane and object detection on a live video stream using OpenCV.

projects.name: Movie recommendation system
projects.summary: Recommend movies through collaborative filtering, starting with a movie title.
projects.details: The system takes a movie title as input and uses collaborative filtering to recommend other movies.

projects.name: Game recommendation system
projects.summary: Find related games using collaborative filtering and a game title as input.
projects.details: A game recommendation project that applies collaborative filtering to suggest games based on an input title.

projects.name: Hospital management system
projects.summary: A general-purpose hospital management website backed by PHP and MySQLi.
projects.details: A web application for storing and managing hospital data using PHP and MySQLi.

projects.name: Library management & delivery
projects.summary: Manage library books and follow book deliveries through multiple checkpoints.
projects.details: A program that helps a library manage its books and track deliveries with multiple checkpoints.

projects.name: This corner of the internet
projects.summary: An accessible, responsive portfolio with a lightweight static architecture.
projects.details: The rebuilt portfolio uses semantic HTML, custom CSS, and a small amount of JavaScript. A dependency-free build script turns a single content file into pages that can be hosted on GitHub Pages.
